sections.label: Causeway and Second Link tolls
sections.summary: Tolls at the Causeway and Second Link were introduced in 1998 in response to Malaysia's tolls, and Singapore matches Malaysia's tolls.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Our tolls at the Causeway and the Second Link were introduced in 1998, only in response to Malaysia's decision to levy tolls at both crossings.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: This long-standing policy of matching Malaysia's tolls is to ensure that Malaysia takes into consideration our response whenever they have plans to raise their tolls.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: If Malaysia removes their tolls, we will do likewise.

sections.label: Response to Malaysia Road Charge
sections.summary: Singapore will match the Road Charge in some form if it discriminates Singapore-registered vehicles, confirming its response after Malaysia implements it.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: If it discriminates Singapore-registered vehicles, we will match it in some form.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: We will confirm whether and how we will respond, after Malaysia has implemented their Road Charge and the details become available.
